plan.bed: a scratch copy (stagekit.Stage.scratch) of a small claudeDev VI holding one While Loop, one Add, one Case, one Flat Sequence, two panel controls - created and deleted in the run

inputs.call: call it once on the scratch bed with the arguments its stagexec route passes (stagexec.LVBackend)
inputs.predict: no exception; outcome ok; the census / step diff the route declares

predicted.note: no postcondition (none at this level - measured by the gscript function it calls (row gscript.wire_indicators)); predicted = returns without exception, outcome ok

plan.outcome_contract: none at this level - measured by the gscript function it calls (row gscript.wire_indicators)
plan.pass_if: every input's prediction holds AND the call's standard outcome is the predicted one; handle count flat (+-100) over the run
plan.runs_in: card chat-F3 (real LabVIEW); never this card

records.rule:
gscript.<fn>  PASS = called >= 1 time on the scratch AND every recorded outcome 'ok' (calls inside a declared NEGATIVE
                window are judged by that window's own prediction instead); FAIL = any other outcome (counts + first reason).
  stagekit.op:<verb> / recipes.<fn>  PASS = every declared case ran without an exception, every op the case issued ended
                outcome 'ok' with err '', and the case's own measured check held; FAIL = the case's numbers.
  A function no case reached gets NO record (it is listed as not-run, never as FAIL). A harness error (an exception raised
  before the function under test was called) is reported as HARNESS and records nothing for that case.
